page.overview:
Who is Madoc Brandybuck?

Madoc Brandybuck was a Hobbit of Buckland and the third Master of Buckland.

Madoc was born on SR 1175 (TA 2775) and was the son of Gormadoc Brandybuck and Malva Headstrong. He married Hanna Goldworthy of the Shire and had one son with her, Marmadoc "Masterful". Madoc was the third Master of Buckland from SR 1236 until his death on SR 1277 at age 102.
